messages:
mia: Heads-up: Marketing needs a compact "bench highlight" asset for the webinar slide deck. We're short on time. Can runtime produce a minimal artifact set: summary CSV, 1 PNG heatmap, and a 3-sentence quote we can use on slide 2?

chris: Sure. Do you need coldstart vs warmed? And which model/quant combo?

mia: Yes please. Use the latest pinned model for the launch: redwood/open-llama-7b-v2@20260201. We prefer quant4 for cost highlight. Keep it under 1 slide worth of text.

ram: I'll spin a quick run on the dedicated pool. Will capture 32/128/512 token buckets, p50/p95/p99, and produce heatmap for coldstart vs warmed.

jess: Add a tiny sample pack (2 prompts per bucket) so we can show a screenshot of coherent outputs in the webinar. Non-sensitive prompts only.

runtime-bot: Job queued: job-id=job_1769325000_warmup. Estimated runtime 30m.

maria: Run done. Uploaded artifacts to internal: results/job_1769325000_summary.csv, results/job_1769325000_heatmap.png, samples/slide_snippets.zip.

maria: Suggested 3-line quote: "On redwood/open-llama-7b-v2 (pinned 20260201), quant4 delivers median latency of 58ms for 32-token prompts and estimated cost of $0.065 per 1k tokens. Warmed p95 across buckets remained below 500ms; coldstart p95 showed a 1.7x delta on long completions."

mia: Perfect, thanks! Uploading slide assets to the deck now.

chris: Note: we kept the manifest immutable and linked to s3 bucket: s3://redwood-marketing/webinar/bench-highlights/manifest-v1.csv. If you need more detail, ask for the full run dump.

mia: That's all for now. If the webinar team wants a live demo, we might do a small live call to runtime to show a warm vs cold request. I'll coordinate separately.

maria: Happy to join the demo. Keep queries small and no multimodal samples.

ram: Closing job job_1769325000_warmup.

mia: Thanks team :tada:
